vo_open.text: A dead whale can feed the deep sea for up to a hundred years.

vo.text: When a whale dies, it sinks. Often more than a thousand meters, into total darkness.
vo.cap: When a whale dies, *it sinks.* Often *1,000+ meters* down. Into total darkness.

vo.text: First come the hagfish and sleeper sharks.
They strip up to sixty kilos of flesh a day.
vo.cap: Up to *60 kg* of flesh a day.

vo.text: Then come bone-eating worms. They dissolve the bones with acid.
vo.cap: Then: *bone-eating worms.* They dissolve bone with *acid.*

vo.text: Last, bacteria feed on the fat inside the bones. For fifty, maybe a hundred years.
vo.cap: Then *bacteria* eat the fat inside the bones. For *50... maybe 100 years.*

vo.text: But humans hunted the great whales.
That may have cut life in the deep sea by more than thirty percent.
vo.cap: That may have cut deep-sea life by *more than 30%.*

vo.text: Right now, there may be six hundred ninety thousand whale falls down there.
vo.cap: Right now, there may be *690,000* whale falls down there.
